verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions provides GitHub Actions-compatible YAML workflows that trigger automatically on repo events (push, PR, etc.), and webhooks/API allow custom automation rules to fire on additional events. This directly satisfies 'rules that trigger actions automatically on events.' Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of Actions triggers in practice, and any AI-native-specific tooling or examples (e.g., AI agent hooked to webhook events) beyond generic docs.
